description: This file defines the ADODB_XML PHP class, which provides methods for manipulating XML files related to database operations, including converting database tables to XML, inserting XML data into a database, and managing XML file structure. It is part of a larger project that interacts with databases and XML files.
external_methods: ADODB classic library functions like $dbConnection->SetFetchMode() and $dbConnection->Execute()

classes.name: ADODB_XML
classes.description: A class for manipulating XML files in the context of database operations, including conversion from SQL query results to XML, and inserting XML data into a database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ADODB_XML object with optional XML version, encoding, and temporary directory.

methods.name: ConvertToXMLString
methods.description: Converts a database table query result to an XML string.

methods.name: ConvertToXML
methods.description: Converts a database query result to an XML file.

methods.name: InsertIntoDB
methods.description: Reads an XML file and inserts its data into a specified database table.

methods.name: setRootTagName
methods.description: Sets the name of the root XML tag.

methods.name: setRowTagName
methods.description: Sets the name of the row XML tags.

methods.name: getRootTagName
methods.description: Returns the current root tag name.

methods.name: getRowTagName
methods.description: Returns the current row tag name.
